subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept optional top-level `res.meta` on v4 Gateway response frames without a protocol version bump once this PR is rebased?
rationale: The implementation is a narrow fix for dropped metadata, but changing the public response envelope can affect strict generated clients and needs maintainer intent rather than an automated policy guess.

options.title: Accept additive `res.meta` after rebase
options.body: Resolve the dirty merge, keep `meta` optional and absent when unused, and treat strict old-client rejection as an acceptable additive-v4 compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Require a versioned or alternate metadata contract
options.body: Pause this branch until the metadata is version-gated, moved into method payloads, or otherwise exposed without changing the v4 top-level response envelope.

options.title: Close in favor of a new protocol-direction PR
options.body: If maintainers do not want additive response-frame fields, close this PR and ask for a new proposal that starts from the chosen protocol contract.

recommendation.title: Accept additive `res.meta` after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty merge, keep `meta` optional and absent when unused, and treat strict old-client rejection as an acceptable additive-v4 compatibility tradeoff.
